basic_details.short_information: The National Legal Services Authority (NALSA), Government of India, has 1 vacancy for Consultant (Legal) on contract basis for the Project Monitoring Unit (PMU) of the Legal Aid Defense Counsel System (LADCS) Scheme and others, posted at New Delhi. Applications in the prescribed proforma must be emailed to [email protected] by 16 December 2026; applications received after the due date will not be entertained.

qualification.details: There is 1 post of Consultant (Legal), engaged on contractual basis from the open market. | Essential qualification: Graduate in Law. Desirable qualification: Post-Graduate in Law. Experience: Sound legal experience of working in criminal matters or Legal Service Institutions. Age limit: Not more than 50 years as on the last date for receipt of applications, i.e. 16/12/2026. Monthly remuneration: ₹ 80,000/-. The remuneration is all inclusive and consolidated; no additional benefits like DA, HRA, Pension, Accommodation, CGHS benefits etc. are payable. TA/DA: The Consultant (Legal) shall be allowed to undertake domestic tours as required by the duties, for which TA/DA and hotel accommodation shall be paid as admissible to Central Government employees in Pay Level 6. Leave: 12 (Twelve) days in a year on pro-rata basis. The leave cannot be combined or extended into the next year of engagement. Additional leave without pay would be permitted only upon approval by the competent authority. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

selection_process: The selection shall be made in accordance with the provisions of the General Financial Rules (GFR)
Chapter 7 'Selection of Individual consultants/ service providers' (para 7.1 and 7.2) and Chapter 6 (para 6.5) of the Manual for Procurement of Consultancy & Other Services 2017.

Shortlisting: Applications received shall be placed before the Selection Committee. Only short-listed candidates who fulfil the desired eligibility will be intimated for interview. Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for the interview/selection process. Assessment of suitability: The Selection Committee shall evaluate candidates based on their work experience and the requirements of the Authority
and alignment with organizational needs. Decision: The decision of the Selection Committee shall be final and binding
shall be communicated to the selected candidate(s) in writing through email
and shall not be subject to appeal or review. Panel: The Committee shall prepare a panel of 3 names per vacancy
which will include 2 persons in the waiting list
subject to receipt of adequate applications. The panel would be valid for a period of one year.
The Selection Committee reserves the right to modify or adjust the selection criteria as deemed necessary.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely on contract basis and will not confer any right for regular appointment in NALSA. The tenure is one year from the date of joining, which may be extended on satisfactory performance, on year-to-year basis and on requirement basis. The engagement can be terminated at any time without assigning any reason; in the normal course, one month's notice will be given, and the Consultant (Legal) must also give one month's notice to leave. Police verification will be done as per the latest instructions of the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), and a medical-cum-fitness certificate from any authorized Medical Practitioner must be submitted prior to engagement. Except with the previous sanction of NALSA or in the bona fide discharge of duties, the Consultant shall not publish a book or articles, take part in a radio broadcast, or write to newspapers or periodicals on subject matter assigned by NALSA. Under exceptional circumstances and for meritorious candidates, the guidelines may be relaxed with the approval of the Competent Authority, NALSA. NALSA reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning reasons, to cancel the recruitment process at any stage, and to withdraw the vacancy circular at any point of time.

content_sections.heading: About NALSA Consultant (Legal)
content_sections.text: The National Legal Services Authority is a Government of India body whose office is at B Block, Ground Floor, Administrative Buildings Complex, Supreme Court of India, New Delhi-110001. The Consultant (Legal) will work for the Project Monitoring Unit (PMU) of the Legal Aid Defense Counsel System (LADCS) Scheme and others under NALSA. The vacancy circular is dated 26 November 2026 and is signed by Rajeev Kr. Yadav, Deputy Secretary.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The NALSA Consultant (Legal) application must be submitted online only, on email. Physical applications will not be entertained. Email address: [email protected] Subject line of the email: "Application for the posts related to PMU, LADCS" (the notice says this must be mentioned). Form to use: the Proforma/Format for the post of Consultant (Legal) given with the vacancy circular. The application format, detailed guidelines and terms and conditions are also available on the NALSA website, www.nalsa.gov.in . Signature: the application must be duly signed. Last date: 16 December 2026. Applications received after the due date shall not be entertained. The proforma asks for: the post applied for, name, father's name, mother's name, gender, date of birth, age as on 16/12/2026 (in yy:mm format), nationality, current and permanent postal addresses with Post Office PIN code and name of Police Station, email ID, telephone and mobile numbers, educational qualifications (Bachelor degree and above) with university, year of passing and division/percentage, work experience from current to oldest, names and contact details of 2 references, a brief statement (maximum 1000 characters) on how the candidate is an outstanding candidate for the job, and a signed declaration with place and date. In the declaration, the candidate certifies that no administrative or criminal case is pending against him or her before any court or authorized body, that he or she has never been found guilty or convicted of any administrative offence or crime, and that the originals of all documents will be produced if selected and appointed.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is 1 post of Consultant (Legal), engaged on contractual basis from the open market. Essential qualification: Graduate in Law. Desirable qualification: Post-Graduate in Law. Experience: Sound legal experience of working in criminal matters or Legal Service Institutions. Age limit: Not more than 50 years as on the last date for receipt of applications, i.e. 16/12/2026. Monthly remuneration: ₹ 80,000/-. The remuneration is all inclusive and consolidated; no additional benefits like DA, HRA, Pension, Accommodation, CGHS benefits etc. are payable. TA/DA: The Consultant (Legal) shall be allowed to undertake domestic tours as required by the duties, for which TA/DA and hotel accommodation shall be paid as admissible to Central Government employees in Pay Level 6. Leave: 12 (Twelve) days in a year on pro-rata basis. The leave cannot be combined or extended into the next year of engagement. Additional leave without pay would be permitted only upon approval by the competent authority. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: NALSA Consultant (Legal) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Consultant (Legal) will be required to provide high quality inputs in the LADCS scheme, which will include the following: Liaison with Department of Justice, State Legal Services Authorities (SLSAs), District Legal Services Authorities (DLSAs) and other stakeholders w.r.t. various reports/data. Giving legal assistance to legal aid seekers who physically come to NALSA for legal aid and assistance. Reply towards the clarification sought by any SLSAs or any DLSA, LADCs related to LADCS scheme. Management/utilization of funds w.r.t. LADCS Scheme. Handling of litigations including updation on LACMS portal. Compliance to latest guidelines issued by Ministry of Finance/NITI Aayog, etc. w.r.t. new/existing schemes. Inputs regarding Output-Outcome Monitoring Framework (OOMF) and tabling them in the Parliament in consultation with D/o Justice, Ministry of Finance and NITI Aayog. Reply to Parliament Questions and RTIs. MIS dashboard of LADCS scheme. Provide technical inputs in implementation of scheme activities, including course corrections, where required. Provide support to NALSA through miscellaneous activities including preparations of PowerPoint Presentations (PPT), speeches, concept notes, press releases, case reviews, etc. Monitoring the day-to-day progress of LADCS scheme. Any other work apart from the above allocated from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application duly signed, in the prescribed format. Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates. Self-attested copies of experience certificates. Incomplete applications and applications not in the prescribed format shall not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection shall be made in accordance with the provisions of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017 under Rules 177 to 196, Chapter 7 'Selection of Individual consultants/ service providers' (para 7.1 and 7.2) and Chapter 6 (para 6.5) of the Manual for Procurement of Consultancy & Other Services 2017. Shortlisting: Applications received shall be placed before the Selection Committee. Only short-listed candidates who fulfil the desired eligibility will be intimated for interview. Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for the interview/selection process. Assessment of suitability: The Selection Committee shall evaluate candidates based on their work experience and the requirements of the Authority, considering relevant work experience, skills and qualifications, and alignment with organizational needs. Decision: The decision of the Selection Committee shall be final and binding, shall be communicated to the selected candidate(s) in writing through email, and shall not be subject to appeal or review. Panel: The Committee shall prepare a panel of 3 names per vacancy, which will include 2 persons in the waiting list, subject to receipt of adequate applications. The panel would be valid for a period of one year. The Selection Committee reserves the right to modify or adjust the selection criteria as deemed necessary.
